FangValley_Text_Npc0.en: HOUNDOUR hunts in packs. Never run\nalone.
FangValley_Text_Npc0.fr: MALOSSE chasse en meute. Ne cours\njamais seul.

FangValley_Text_Npc1.en: ZANGOOSE and SEVIPER fight each\nother. Always.

FangValley_Text_Quest0_Ask.en: Poison is everywhere. Two FULL\nHEALs, and BLACK GLASSES are yours.
FangValley_Text_Quest0_Ask.fr: Le poison est partout. Deux\nTOUT-SOIN, et les LUNETTES NOIRES\lsont à toi.

FangValley_Text_Quest0_Done.en: You are a lifesaver! Take these\nBLACK GLASSES.
FangValley_Text_Quest0_Done.fr: Tu es un sauveur ! Prends ces\nLUNETTES NOIRES.

FangValley_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
FangValley_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.fr: Ton SAC est plein ! Fais de la\nplace et reviens me voir.

FangValley_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

FangValley_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.

FangValley_Text_TopazeFindFull.en: Something shines here, but your BAG\nis full.
FangValley_Text_TopazeFindFull.fr: Quelque chose brille ici, mais ton\nSAC est plein.
